sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-MLX: Image-to-Text model - aimodels.fyi
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-MLX is a 27-billion-parameter vision-language model built by orcarouter that runs on Apple Silicon through MLX quantization. It is based on Qwen's Qwen3.8-27B architecture, which uses hybrid attention combining 48 Gated DeltaNet linear layers with 16 full attention layers across 64 total layers and 5120 hidden dimensions.
